acs.text_first_line: AC1 The OpenAPI document declares the two audit reads and nothing else
AC2 The answer resource carries the eleven audit elements and the legacy elements
AC3 The filters, the paging shape and the export media type are fixed
AC4 The audit read is read-only and no operation can change an entry
AC5 The authorisation element names the right, the scope and the authorise contract
AC6 The error envelope maps one message ID per condition
AC7 Additive change stays in major version 1 and a breaking change raises version 2
AC8 The six fakes answer the document and the drift test fails a build on any difference
